pageSub: Your plan, seats, invoices and billing details.
adminSub: Plans, subscriptions, seat use and GST invoices for every organisation. Razorpay runs in test mode until the account is verified.
deniedBody: Ask an owner of your organisation to open this page.
deniedSupport: Billing is not available in a support session.
loadErrorBody: Billing could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
demoNotice: Demo: nothing was saved or sent.
seatsUnlimited: {used} seats used, no limit on this plan
seatsFull: All seats are in use. Remove a member or move to a plan with more seats to invite someone new.
seatsOver: You are over your seat limit. Existing members keep access; new invitations are blocked.
bannerTrialEnded: Your trial has ended. The workspace is read-only until you subscribe.
bannerCancelled: Your subscription has ended. The workspace is read-only until you subscribe again.
bannerPastDue: A payment is overdue. Pay it to avoid the workspace turning read-only.
bannerPastDueReadonly: A payment is overdue and the workspace is read-only until it is paid.
bannerSuspended: This organisation is suspended. Everything is read-only. Contact support to restore it.
bannerTrialEnding: Your trial ends soon. Subscribe to keep writing.
plansSub: Prices exclude GST. GST is added at checkout and shown on every invoice.
plansEmpty: No plans are open for self-service yet. Your account manager invoices pilots directly.
cancelConfirm: Cancel the subscription at the end of the paid period?
detailsSub: Used on every invoice. Add your GSTIN to receive a tax invoice in your company name.
readonlyHint: Read-only: subscribe or pay to make changes elsewhere in the app.
subscribeStarted: Subscription created. Continue to Razorpay to authorise the payment.
cancelRequested: Cancellation requested. You keep access until the end of the paid period.
err_no_subscription: This organisation has no billing record yet. Contact support.
err_price_not_set: That plan has no price yet. Contact your account manager.
err_issuer_unconfigured: Invoicing is not configured on the platform yet. Contact support.
err_razorpay_unconfigured: Online payment is not set up yet. Contact your account manager to be invoiced.
err_live_refused: Online payment is switched off until the platform's payment account is verified.
err_razorpay_error: The payment provider refused the request. Try again or contact support.
err_already_active: You are already on that plan.
err_no_provider_subscription: There is no online subscription to cancel.
err_bad_gstin: That GSTIN is not valid. Check the 15 characters.
err_bad_transition: That status change is not allowed.
err_duplicate_period: An invoice already exists for that period.
err_bad_period: Enter a start date and an end date on or after it.
err_bad_amount: Enter the amount in rupees, 0 or more.
err_reason_required: Give a reason of at least 8 characters.
err_denied: You do not have permission to do that.
adminDenied: Billing is only open to platform billing and super admin roles.
adminReadOnlyNote: You can read billing. Changes need the billing or super admin role.
plansAdminSub: Prices are in rupees, tax exclusive. Limits left blank are unlimited. Changing a price starts a new Razorpay plan on next checkout.
invoicesAdminSub: Pilots are invoiced outside Razorpay: create the invoice, issue it, mark it paid when the money arrives.
pdfNeedsConfig: The invoice PDF needs the issuer configuration.
